label: cross-environment (D-032): ratios between separate campaigns in different environments and toolchains; the harness is pinned to one CPU in WSL and unpinned on Windows, so only chain time, POSTs, requests and depth are compared. v4 dev key; loopback, same host; traced ethers clients (wrapper code runs per request; R0's E4 figures are untraced).

cr_wsl.key: dev (v4 Groth16 dev key; proving untimed)
cr_wsl.network: loopback, same host (D-034): the node listens on 127.0.0.1 of the same laptop (per target: target.endpoint)
cr_wsl.clients: traced ethers clients (wrapper code runs per request; R0's E4 figures are untraced)
cr_wsl.variants: only A asShipped and the read set sequentialShipped are as shipped; every other variant is 'variant, not shipped' (D-034)
